changes_made.explanation: Consolidated task description to 'Other:Context Generation for Medical QA'. Normalized model names with consistent version formatting. Removed duplicate dataset entries and consolidated outputs.
Removed RAGAS metrics (Context Recall, Context Precision, Faithfulness) as they are part of LLM-as-judge evaluation, not automatic metrics. Accuracy and Recall@K are the true automatic metrics used.
Normalized model name to GPT-4-Turbo and consolidated method descriptions. Criteria remain unchanged as they are explicitly mentioned.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on context generation for medical question answering, which qualifies as an NLG task. The extraction was generally accurate but contained some duplicates and inconsistent formatting. The paper uses both automatic metrics (Accuracy, Recall@K) and LLM-as-judge evaluation (RAGAS with GPT-4-Turbo), along with expert human evaluation.
